support.title: Support
support.description: Rentopya support: contact details and answers to common questions about accounts, sign-in, account deletion and privacy.
support.intro: Write to us with questions, bug reports or suggestions about Rentopya. Mention your company name and the screen where the problem happened so we can help faster.
support.contact_hours: We reply to messages on business days.
support.faq_account_q: How do I open an account for my company?
support.faq_account_a: Email us to open a company account or request a demo. Company admins add staff accounts by sending invitations from the panel.
support.faq_signin_q: I can't sign in. What should I do?
support.faq_signin_a: Use the forgot password step on the sign-in screen. If you are a staff member, ask your admin to confirm that your account and company access are active. If the problem continues, email us.
support.faq_delete_q: How do I delete my account?
support.faq_delete_a: You can delete your account in the mobile app or on the Profile page of the web panel, and restore it within 30 days.
support.faq_privacy_a: Our privacy policy explains which data we process and why.

support.faq_customer_q: I am a customer of a rental company. Who do I contact about my reservation?
support.faq_customer_a: For reservations, payments, contracts and your personal data, contact the company you rented from directly. Rentopya provides the software these companies use.
